THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I , Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

Two allotments of land depicted morefully in below in the Advance Tracing No. Ya/TLL/2021/166 dated 20.12.2021 prepared by the Surveyor General Situated in the village called Tellipalai East in Thanthaiselvapuram (J/230) Grama Niladhari Division in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Valikamam North (Tellippalai) in Jaﬀ na District of Northern Province and bounded as follows.

01. Lot 'A' – Thottharai – Extent: 0.0418 Hectare North: Thottarai Claimed by Thanabalasingam Kiritharan and Mankalam Manisekaran and path; East: Path and Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); South: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha) and Thottaai claimed by J/Mahajana College, Tellippalai; West:
Thottarai, claimed by J/Mahajana College Tellippalai, Thanabalasingam Kiritharan and Mankalam Manisekaran.

02. Lot 'B' – Thottharai – Extent: 0.0122 Hectare North: Thottarai Claimant not known and claimed by J/Mahajana College, Tellippalai; East: Thottarai claimed by J/Mahajana College, Tellippalai and Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); South: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); West: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha), Thottarai, claimed by Uruthiramoorthy Premanath and Claimant not known.
K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
